activity_now_ref_chk.name: activity_now_ref_chk
activity_now_ref_chk.value: "activity_reports"."now_ref_hash" is null or "activity_reports"."now_kind" is not null

chat_messages_dm_chk.name: chat_messages_dm_chk
chat_messages_dm_chk.value: ("chat_messages"."kind" = 'dm') = ("chat_messages"."dm_low" is not null and "chat_messages"."dm_high" is not null)

pet_messages_source_chk.name: pet_messages_source_chk
pet_messages_source_chk.value: ("pet_messages"."author" = 'pet') = ("pet_messages"."source" is not null) and ("pet_messages"."source" is null or "pet_messages"."source" in ('claude_code_channel','cowork_scheduled','claude_interactive','claude_code'))

pet_messages_owner_fields_chk.name: pet_messages_owner_fields_chk
pet_messages_owner_fields_chk.value: ("pet_messages"."author" = 'owner') = ("pet_messages"."client_msg_id" is not null) and ("pet_messages"."author" = 'owner') = ("pet_messages"."answer_state" is not null)

pet_messages_pet_fields_chk.name: pet_messages_pet_fields_chk
pet_messages_pet_fields_chk.value: ("pet_messages"."author" = 'pet') = ("pet_messages"."in_reply_to" is not null) and ("pet_messages"."author" = 'pet') = ("pet_messages"."reply_part" is not null) and ("pet_messages"."reply_part" is null or "pet_messages"."reply_part" between 1 and 3)

pet_messages_claim_chk.name: pet_messages_claim_chk
pet_messages_claim_chk.value: ("pet_messages"."claimed_by" is null) = ("pet_messages"."claim_until" is null) and ("pet_messages"."claim_until" is null or "pet_messages"."answer_state" = 'claimed')

pets_role_len_chk.name: pets_role_len_chk
pets_role_len_chk.value: "pets"."role_instructions" is null or char_length("pets"."role_instructions") between 1 and 1000
